Celebrations

Melon strip plate

Dinnyetál

8 months+ Adjusted 10 min 2 portions

Suitable from 8 months. Stay beside the child, and mash any piece that is still round or slippery.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 150 g ripe melon (rind and seeds removed; cut in long strips, not balls)
  • 40 g soft berries (raspberries or ripe strawberries; no grapes)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Choose a ripe melon and cut away the rind and seeds.
  2. Slice the flesh into long strips, not round balls.
  3. Crush or quarter the berries so no round piece stays whole.
  4. Arrange the strips and berries on a plate.
  5. Serve at once with no sugar and no skewers.

Adjusted

A round slippery piece can block the airway.

Cut ripe melon into long strips, not round balls, and serve it with soft berries. Use no sugar and no skewers, and let the plate look like a cake if you like.
